title: The Horizon of Station Meridian Again
author: Jude Sandoval
blurb: Tamsin Winterbourne, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
